function.name: EventSettingsApi_create_website_alert_config
function.description: Creates a configuration for website alerts, defining the conditions under which alerts are triggered and their severity. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name for the website alert configuration.

description.description: A brief description of the website alert configuration.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert, which indicates its importance.

triggering.description: Flag to determine whether an incident is also triggered when the alert is activated.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website this alert configuration is associated with.

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression defining the scope of relevant website beacons through tag filters.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes, defining the tumbling window size for threshold violation detection.

rule.description: The type of rule for the alert configuration, such as 'response_time' or 'error_rate'.

threshold.description: The value above which the specified rule type is considered to be violated. This is a float type value.

timeThreshold.description: The time duration in minutes within which the threshold must be violated to trigger the alert.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of alert channel IDs that are notified when the alert is triggered.

function.name: enable_infra_alert_config
function.description: Enables the specified infrastructure alert configuration, allowing alerts to be triggered based on the defined criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the infrastructure alert configuration to be enabled.

function.name: create_infra_alert_config
function.description: Creates a new infrastructure alert configuration, allowing users to define conditions and thresholds for system alerts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the alert configuration.

threshold.description: The numerical threshold at which the alert should be triggered.

enabled.description: A flag that enables or disables the alert configuration.

alert_type.description: The type of alert to configure, such as 'cpu', 'memory', or 'disk_space'.

duration.description: The duration in minutes that the threshold must be exceeded before triggering the alert.

notification_emails.description: A list of email addresses to be notified when the alert is triggered.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert, which can be 'critical', 'warning', or 'info'.
